label: No direct contingent supporter of a…: Whenever a source exists at world w and directly supports…
term: no direct contingent supporter of a necessary bearer
definition: Whenever a source exists at world w and directly supports the existence of a bearer necessary from w₀, the source is also necessary from w₀. This does not restrict all efficient causes, events or explanatory tokens.
note: Independent open metaphysical commitment. The two-world contingent-intermediary model proves that it is not derivable from rigid population, actual/worldwise well-foundedness and a well-founded union among necessary individuals.
